quarterly_data.quarter: Lite-On press release: LITEON Announces Strategic Investment in Liquid Cooling (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lite-On announced a strategic investment in DCX POLSKA Sp. z o.o. (DCX Liquid Cooling Systems), a Warsaw, Poland-based provider of liquid cooling systems for AI and HPC data centers (direct-to-chip and immersion; coolant distribution units from 600kW-2.6MW enterprise CDUs to hyperscale-class facility CDUs of up to 16MW, plus cold plates, rack manifolds and modular data center systems); on closing Lite-On will hold approximately 25% equity. The companies will jointly develop integrated power-and-cooling platforms for hyperscale data center customers, combining DCX's liquid cooling with Lite-On's AI server power management, rack-level power delivery and 800VDC power architectures, and expand collaboration across product development, engineering, manufacturing scale-up and global go-to-market. Chairman Tom Soong: the investment 'further strengthens LITEON's position across the AI data center value chain.'
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 25% equity in DCX; DCX CDUs 600kW-2.6MW, facility CDUs up to 16MW
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: investee and liquid cooling development partner
